posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
With a last crackle and a fizz the Terra-Lunar Impulsion beam was destroyed.  The Earth safe Legacy turned to face Baron Blade, "Give it up Blade, it's over."

"No, Legacy, this isn't over, this is far from over."  Baron Blade furiously punched keys on his control panel then turned back to the heroes, "Your time is at an end, but my time has just begun!"  As Blade put the helmet to his power suit on the Mars Base lights turned Red and began flashing.

"Self-Destruct sequence activated."

The Entire base started to vibrate with a strange hum, the entire room felt heavy.  Electricity arced across the floor and ceiling.  Whatever was happening it couldn't be good.

On Flip:

Baron Blade is restored to 30hp.

Trash is shuffled into the deck and the Mobile Weapons platforms removed.  Self-Destruct sequence enters play and the top two cards of the environment deck are placed face down beside it.

Self Destruct Sequence is indestructible.

Gameplay:

All the normal and advanced rules apply, Blade takes -1 damage, deals highest hp hero 5 energy damage at turn end.  

Special difficulty mode rule:  At the start of the villain turn, play the top card of the villain deck.

 

Time Cataclysm deck enters play.

Time Cataclysm special rules:

Time Cataclysm will have its own turn called the time cataclysm turn, ll references to environment on Time Cataclysm cards only refer to the Time Cataclysm turn, and time cataclysm cards.

Rift in time# comes into play, it will remain marked (#), that card is indestructible unless it is the only time cataclysm card in play at the start of the time cataclysm turn, at which point it destroys itself and the game ends.

Main Computer Room and Oppressive Smog enter play.

 

Explanation:

So something is wrong, and it involves the base being in self-destruct mode and also some type of time distortion.  The heroes need to defeat Baron Blade while managing both the self-destruct possibility and the time cataclysm event.

The time cataclysm deck and Wagner Mars base operate independently, they do not effect each other (except that they treat each other as non-environment/time cataclysm targets), hence not calling the time cataclysm deck or turn Environment.

The time cataclysm deck starts with two cards in play (other than rift) so you don't lose right off the bat.  Time Cataclysm will play between the Environment and Villain turn.

This may seem needlessly complex, but it fits the plot.

The best option is to just beat Blade as fast as possible, if the fight drags out at all the rift and self-destruct will become a problem.

Blade:  30hp (cannot deal damage)

In Play:  Blade Battalion [5]

Trash:  Mobile Defense Platform (3)

 

Mars Base

In Play:  Fire in the Biosphere, Self Destruct Sequence (indestructible)

ST:  1 player may discard two cards to destroy fire in the biosphere.  If the countdown pile contains 7 cards the sequence is aborted, otherwise discard the top card of the countdown pile.

ET:  Fire in the biosphere deals each target 2 fire damage, then each hero may destroy 1 ongoing card or take 2 fire damage.

Special:  At the start of a hero turn a hero may skip the rest of their turn to put the top card of the environment deck onto the countdown pile.

             If the Countdown pile is ever empty the base destructs, game over.

 

Time Cataclysm

In Play:  Rift in Time#, Main Computer Room [9], Oppressive Smog

ST:  If Rift in Time# is the only Time Cataclysm card in play the cataclysm envelops the base, game over. Destroy one Time Cataclysm card. (rift in time#) Each player may draw a card. (computer room)  One player may discard one card to destroy oppressive smog.
